arm_why: section 6.5's ratios read as ALBEDO: top 1.11x and face 0.60x the floor's own anchor of 101.16. No rig baked into the asset.

planes.face_only_note: face tiles are RGBA with the top band cut away. The cap is a continuous field selected by world position and is drawn underneath; a face tile carrying its own top band would put block material against the field beside it.

grain.donor_role: AMPLITUDE ONLY - the residual still carries the donor's own course pitch, so its pixels cannot be laid as grain without laying its bond with them (section 13.7).

donors.verdict: FAIL - 'rows 0-4 use the identical greys as the face, so there is no top band at all ... flat brick wallpaper with zero thickness'

age_note: RULED (Rafe, at the gate): the walls had opted out of history. Age is keyed to TrafficField - the floor's own accumulated-traversal field, in which vaults and shrines sit at exactly zero - so a wall beside a route ages and a sealed room's wall stays sharp. Base courses only; patina climbs one course at the age above. Expressed as darkening and as ROUNDING, never as a pale value lift (section 8.2.1).
contact_seam: NOT DRAWN HERE - the floor family carries it per edge (WALL-RECIPE 3.1, bible 12.1). A seam baked into a wall tile is present on every side the tile is used, which is a ring.
plant: LOOP-PROCESS §4. A picturesquely RUINED wall against bible §8.1's 'nothing is ruined, things are used up'. NEVER LANDS. NEVER SHOWN TO RAFE. If the plant seat does not cull it, the round is VOID.
